title: Slimes slimy Adventurepack
description: A Lightweight modpack focused on adventuring
body:
This modpack is a lightweight pack designed around adventure, exploration and dungeons. Included are a handful of mods to give variety when it comes to combat and to encourage the creative basebuilding of minecraft.

It includes a small questsystem (accessible with the 'U' key) designed to lead players towards the different mods' introductions.

Some of the mods included are:\
Mana and Artifice by Mithion\
(including its addon Arcane Additions by nivthefox)\
Create by simibubi\
Tinkers' Construct by KnightMiner\
Spartan Weaponry by ObliviousSpartan\
When Dungeons Arise by aureljz\
Dungeon Crawl by xyroc\
Dungeons Enhanced by Ametrin Studios\
Effortless Building by Huskuraft\
Several performance mods
